impl.residual_risk: M13 hides the card via toolCatalogRecordsForSession using a catalogue-local predicate (isCaringContactsToolListed) that reads only NODE_ENV and NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE, because the real predicate (isCaringContactsDemoEnabled) is server-only and reads PLAYWRIGHT_OFFLINE_MODE, which never reaches the client bundle; the two are proved equal by test in every environment src/instrumentation.ts lets a server start in, and the test pins the instrumentation refusal string, but it is a mirror, not a shared function. The isolated Playwright production server (NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE=true) still lists the card; a hypothetical future production build that inlined NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE=true at build time but not at runtime could produce a server/client disagreement, which today cannot happen because instrumentation refuses such a process. ClinicalDashboard.tsx (not owned) still shows toolCatalogRecords.length as the Tools count, so a production composer count may read one higher than the cards offered. L113 makes toolCatalogRecordById throw rather than return undefined, because its one caller (tool-fixtures.ts, not owned) dereferences the result and would not typecheck against an optional return; the throw fires at module load of the mockup fixtures for a bad id, which the existing fixture test catches. L50 adds no env.ts entry (not owned); the .env.example comment is what check:env-parity now sees. L74 corrects the HANDOVER and PROGRESS-LEDGER only; docs/caring-contacts/phase-2b-CONTINUATION-PROMPT.md still describes the pre-merge branch state and points at the HANDOVER (now bannered).
